item.title: Kinrox 0.4.0
item.description:
Spotify music mode, queue editing, favorites and localized connection documents. Requires an Apple Silicon Mac with macOS 14 Sonoma or later. Version 0.4.0, build 6.

Download Kinrox-0.4.0-arm64.dmg, open it, and drag Kinrox to Applications. All video playback libraries are bundled; Homebrew and Xcode are not required. Users of 0.3.0 can use Check for Updates. Earlier versions can install this DMG directly.

New

  • Music library with albums, tracks, catalogue search and a compact three-column view.
  • Track likes, saved albums and followed artists, with favorite undo and playlist options.
  • Editable queue with duplicate occurrences, shuffle, repeat, reordering and removal.
  • Official Spotify Connect playback through a private Kinrox Queue playlist.
  • Coordinated video/music playback and shared system media keys.
  • Music controls, queue and favorites through the encrypted iPhone LAN connection. These require a companion build containing music support; this release does not publish a new iPhone app to the App Store.
  • Spotify attribution, playback restrictions, recovery actions and bundled connection terms/privacy documents in all 30 supported app languages.
  • Updated component licensing and project information. The Mac remains GPL-3.0-only; new iPhone source revisions use the personal-use license described in LICENSING.md.

Spotify setup and behavior

Spotify is optional. It requires Spotify Premium, the official Spotify app on the same Mac, and your own Spotify developer app Client ID. Add http://127.0.0.1:43821/callback to that app's redirect URIs. Development Mode accounts must be allowed by that developer app.

In Kinrox Settings → Spotify, read and accept the connection terms, enter the public Client ID, then connect in your browser. No client secret is requested. Open Music with Command-2; Command-F searches and Command-R refreshes.

Audio plays in Spotify.app. Kinrox sends Spotify requests only from Mac; iPhone controls stay on the LAN, while user-activated Spotify links open externally. Credentials remain in the Mac Keychain. Disconnect clears local credentials and cache but leaves the helper playlist and intentional library edits in Spotify. Unliking a track removes its copies from editable playlists; Command-Z can undo the latest favorite action. Artist follows remain independent.

Read the connection terms and privacy policy before connecting.

Limits and verification

Spotify API polling can delay updates. Duplicate playlist occurrences cannot always be distinguished after external playback changes. No album artwork is shown. Spotify availability and developer-app access are controlled by Spotify; this release does not imply Spotify approval.

Runtime checks use macOS 26.5.2. macOS 14 and iOS 17 are deployment targets, not separately tested devices in this release session. Earlier physical-iPhone music checks are documented in Music Verification.

Kinrox-0.4.0-dependency-sources.tar.gz contains dependency sources, build recipes and patches. Licenses are included in the app. SHA256SUMS.txt provides asset checksums; matching application source is available at tag v0.4.0.

item.title: Kinrox 0.3.0
item.description:
Matrix screensaver, live folder playlists, and update reminders for Mac. Requires an Apple Silicon Mac with macOS 14 Sonoma or later. Version 0.3.0, build 5.

Download Kinrox-0.3.0-arm64.dmg, open it, and drag Kinrox to Applications. All playback libraries are bundled; Homebrew and Xcode are not required.

New

  • Matrix screensaver: choose Screensaver → Matrix. A playing movie pauses before the falling green code appears. Esc returns to the paused movie without leaving fullscreen. Matrix also works with no video open.
  • Live folder playlists: newly available videos appear in Next/Previous navigation without reopening the current file. Changes also reach the iPhone remote and system media controls. Playback position is preserved.
  • Update reminders: Kinrox checks for updates daily and offers a welcome-screen banner, a compact reminder while paused, and Check for Updates in the app menu. Sparkle verifies and installs updates when you choose to update.
  • Project links: the About panel and Help menu link to the website, source, license, support, issue tracker, and privacy policy.

Reliability

  • Matrix waits for the playback engine to confirm pause. Remote start requests report errors or cancellation instead of acknowledging an unconfirmed start.
  • Starting Matrix dismisses the Connect iPhone card; pairing cards retain Esc priority.
  • Folder watching recovers after directory replacement or temporary unavailability, and checks for new episodes at the end of playback.
  • Release startup verification leaves Sparkle's saved update preferences untouched.

Updating from 0.2.0

Versions 0.2.0 and earlier have no built-in updater. Install 0.3.0 manually once; subsequent releases can be offered inside the player.

Playback and remote commands stay on the local network. Update checks read an HTTPS feed on GitHub Pages without unique identifiers, system profiling, or telemetry. Installing an update downloads its signed DMG from GitHub Releases. See the privacy policy.

This is a Mac release. The iPhone App Store release is separate; Matrix remote controls require a companion build with the Screensavers section.

Runtime verification targets macOS 26.5.2. macOS 14 is the deployment target; a separate macOS 14 machine was not used for this release.

Kinrox-0.3.0-dependency-sources.tar.gz contains corresponding dependency sources, build recipes, and patches. Licenses are included inside the app. SHA256SUMS.txt provides release-asset checksums. The matching application source is available at the v0.3.0 tag.
